title: A 24/7 retail voice agent handles product discovery in multiple languages
friendlyTitle: A Japanese retailer tests an AI shopping assistant that never closes
summary: Avatarin and Japanese retailer Yamada Denki built a GPT-Realtime shopping agent that grounds answers in product information, asks follow-up questions and supports voice and text around the clock. About 30,000 shoppers used a two-week public experience, with 92% of survey responses reported as positive.
friendlySummary: The voice and text assistant helps people choose products in several languages and uses store information for its answers. About 30,000 people tried it over two weeks.
whyItMatters: The project illustrates a useful voice-agent pattern: pair low-latency conversation with retrieval, product-specific question flows and guardrails. Retail teams should still examine conversion, error rates and customer preference beyond the positive vendor-reported survey result.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is a clear example of AI helping customers when staff are unavailable. Businesses should also measure wrong answers, sales results and whether customers actually prefer it.
